items.title: Tony Marino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 25, 2025
items.q: And when you listen to Ron Carter and Tony Williams they were flying ahead man

ctx.x: I remember hearing Louis Hayes and I think it was Ron Carter on bass at the Iridium. This was quite a few years ago. And Louis Hayes was so on top of the beat that I couldn’t understand how the song did not speed up like significantly. How is that possible? Man he just like constant push yet not speeding up I guess.

Yeah well you know some people have set it up as a big circle you know. So you could be a little bit ahead you know, or you could be a little behind. We could be right in the middle. I always kind of felt Paul Chambers and that group of Miles Davis were kind of right on the beat you know. And when you listen to Elvin Jones and Jimmy Garrison I always felt they were just a little behind. They left more room for Elvin’s big circular triplety things that he did. And when you listen to Ron Carter and Tony Williams…
